user.title: InPost
user.description:
1. Open [the InPost login page]({login_url}) in your browser and log in exactly as in the app (phone number, SMS code).
2. You end up on a blank or error page whose address starts with `https://account.inpost-group.com/callback?code=`. That is expected.
3. Copy the whole address from the address bar and paste it below. The code is valid for a short time only.

If the page lets you in without asking for anything, you are already logged in in this browser: open the link in a private window.

data.callback_url: Address of the page after login

reauth_confirm.title: Log in to InPost again
reauth_confirm.description: The InPost session has expired. Open [the InPost login page]({login_url}), log in and paste the address of the page you end up on (`https://account.inpost-group.com/callback?code=...`).

data.callback_url: Address of the page after login

error.invalid_callback: This address has no login code, or it comes from another login attempt. Paste the full address of the page shown after logging in via the link above.
error.invalid_auth: InPost rejected the code. It may have expired: log in via the link again and paste the new address right away.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the InPost API.

abort.already_configured: This InPost account is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: You logged in to a different InPost account than the one being re-authenticated.

init.title: Options
init.description: How often to check InPost, and whether to expose the pickup code. The code opens the locker, and attributes are stored in the Home Assistant database.
